interpretation.plain_speak: The memory does not globally switch into a good or bad consolidation mode. Inside the same stream, each item succeeds or fails according to its own timing: two reminders within one window become durable, while two reminders split across the reset do not. Swapping which items get which timing swaps the outcome.
interpretation.north_star_question: Shows that bounded temporal consolidation can operate selectively at item level inside mixed streams, a prerequisite for integrating durable evidence into realistic language sequences.
interpretation.next_stage: test overlapping item phases where different targets enter and leave the same generation at staggered positions, while preserving the two-sighting rule and fixed memory
